cues.text: Tried a problem and still can't see the way? You can watch it solved.
Tap the play button at the end of your step.
Choose Watch. This problem won't count as solved, so it's worth one more try first.
The lesson talks you through each step. Turn on captions to read along.
Tap a step to go back to it, or change the speed.
Rather read it? Written steps shows the same solution.
When you're ready, go on to the next problem and try one yourself.
